canonical_title: CAD-WAM: Anticipating Geometry for Text-to-CAD Generation
abstract: Builds CAD solids step by step, conditioning each modeling action on geometry produced by the CAD kernel.
screening_reason: An LLM chooses executable modeling actions from the target description and observed intermediate solid.

screening_evidence.evidence: Each DSL action executes in a CAD kernel. Surface samples of the resulting solid are encoded as geometric state for the next action; the end action terminates construction.

contribution: Builds CAD solids step by step, conditioning each modeling action on geometry produced by the CAD kernel.
limitations: Next-state prediction is training supervision; it is not evidence of inference-time search or a separate critic.
